content: Cefadroxil for Oral Suspension, USP, is available in the following formulations: 1. 125 mg per 5 mL Suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate equivalent to 125 mg. It is supplied as a light orange-colored powder that forms an orange suspension upon reconstitution with water. The resulting suspension has a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. Packaging: NDC 63304-972-04: 100 mL bottles. 2. 250 mg per 5 mL Suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate equivalent to 250 mg. It is supplied as a light orange-colored powder that forms an orange suspension upon reconstitution with water. The resulting suspension has a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. Packaging: NDC 63304-973-03: 50 mL bottles. NDC 63304-973-04: 100 mL bottles. 3. 500 mg per 5 mL Suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate equivalent to 500 mg. It is supplied as a light orange-colored powder that forms an orange suspension upon reconstitution with water. The resulting suspension has a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. Packaging: NDC 63304-974-01: 75 mL bottles. NDC 63304-974-04: 100 mL bottles. Storage Instructions for Suspensions (Prior to Reconstitution): Store at 20–25°C (68–77°F) as per USP Controlled Room Temperature guidelines. DURICEF® (Cefadroxil Monohydrate, USP) Capsules: 500 mg Capsules: These are opaque, maroon and white hard gelatin capsules, imprinted with “PPP” and “784” on one end, and “DURICEF” and “500 mg” on the other end. Packaging: NDC 0430-0780-19: Bottle of 50 capsules. Storage: Store at controlled room temperature, 15–30°C (59–86°F). DURICEF® Tablets: 1 Gram Tablets: These are white to off-white, oval-shaped tablets with a bisect line. They are imprinted with “PPP” on one side of the bisect and “785” on the other side. Packaging: NDC 0430-0781-19: Bottle of 50 tablets. Storage: Store at controlled room temperature, 15–30°C (59–86°F). DURICEF® for Oral Suspension: This suspension is orange-pineapple flavored and is available in the following formulations: 250 mg/5 mL: NDC 0430-2782-15: 50 mL bottle. NDC 0430-2782-17: 100 mL bottle. 500 mg/5 mL: NDC 0430-2783-16: 75 mL bottle. NDC 0430-2783-17: 100 mL bottle. Storage Instructions for Oral Suspension (Prior to Reconstitution): Store at controlled room temperature, 15–30°C (59–86°F).
